evidence: Matches the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies RPC handler execution and argument validation in src/rpc/blockchain.cpp.
rationale: Prevents file corruption and prune-lock clobbering during concurrent `dumptxoutset` calls while avoiding expensive wasted UTXO copying on stale target blocks. The PR description notes that concurrent runs write to the same temporary path and delete prune locks mid-rollback, while stale targets perform full UTXO copies only to fail at the end. While resolving real corruption and resource waste, `dumptxoutset` is an occasional administrative command rather than a hot RPC, making the fix reasonably deferrable.
